description: US public company verification via SEC EDGAR. Given a ticker, CIK, or company name, returns entity name, CIK, industry (SIC), state of incorporation, exchanges/tickers, address, and latest SEC filing. Ambiguous names return candidates, never a silent selection. Covers SEC-registered PUBLIC companies and funds only -- not private US companies. Call for KYB and counterparty due diligence on listed US entities.

query.description: US public company ticker, SEC CIK, or company name — e.g. "AAPL", "0000320193", or "Apple Inc"

name: verify_us_company
